description:
## What's new

- **Weekly Wrapped only.** Removed monthly and yearly recaps - Weekly Wrapped is now the sole focus.
- **Dynamic year.** Playlist titles now show the actual week instead of hardcoded 2025.
- **Fixed UI overlaps.** Resolved text overlapping in top song, top artist, and playlist screens.
- **Fixed share button overlap.** Increased spacing between buttons.
- **Added share buttons.** Share your top song and top artist as Instagram-style story images.
- **Lunara playlist cover.** Personal Wrapped playlist now uses the Lunara logo instead of the Metrolist cover.
- **Share crash fix.** Share now works reliably without ANR (Canvas-based rendering).
- **Smoother animations.** Reduced animation delays for better responsiveness.
- **Changed top bar.** Updated title to "Lunara Wrapped".
- **Fixed changelogs.** Changelogs are now properly displayed.

Enjoy your weekly music recap!

## What's new

- **Wrapped 2.0.** Completely redesigned Wrapped tab with weekly, monthly and yearly recaps showing actual period names and current year (not hardcoded 2025).
- **Share everywhere.** Share your Wrapped recap - top songs, top artists, top albums, unique songs, unique artists - as Instagram-style story images to any app.
- **Crash fix.** Fixed share crash (ComposeView window attachment error).
- **Clean UI.** Removed "Made with love" text. Fixed text overlaps in Wrapped screens.
- **Dynamic titles.** Wrapped playlist titles now show actual month names and current year.

Enjoy your music recap!

## What's new

- **Compilation fixes.** Resolved Kotlin compilation errors in the Library screen (Wrapped stats, modifier weight, syntax).
- **Wrapped stats.** Wrapped popup now computes real weekly, monthly and yearly play counts from your playback history.
- **Stability.** Various crash fixes and UI stability improvements.

## What's new

Initial release of Lunara.

- **Music playback.** Play, pause, skip and seek with background playback, notification controls and lock screen controls.
- **Library management.** Browse by songs, albums, artists and playlists, create custom playlists, and search your collection.
- **Audio quality.** Built-in equalizer with presets, adjustable playback speed, and a sleep timer.
- **Interface.** Clean modern design with light and dark theme support.
